name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-review-customer-packet
title: Review Customer Packet
shortDescription: Reviews a completed customer packet against its application and the packet rulebook, reconciles every VIN, and sets Customer Ready only after the reviewer confirms.
longDescription: Derives the expected document list from the application and packet-manifest.md, reads the merged PDF, and shows an expected-versus-found table with evidence.
Reconciles proof-of-insurance cards and vehicle schedules VIN by VIN. Freezes an immutable review receipt and updates one column, Packet status, only after the exact confirmation phrase.
